## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `make vet`, `make test-race` pass; code is gofmt-clean
- [ ] Tests added or updated (table-driven; real SQLite, no store mocks)
- [ ] DESIGN.md updated if behaviour, API, log events or metrics changed
- [ ] README or docs updated if flags or usage changed
- [ ] No secrets, hostnames, internal addresses or recordings in the diff
